outgoing.name: 18th century
outgoing.excerpt: By the eighteenth century, the commercial value of Humpback Whales had been realized, and they became a common prey of whalers for many years.

outgoing.name: Extinction
outgoing.excerpt: To prevent species extinction, a general moratorium on the hunting of Humpbacks was introduced in 1966 and is still in force today.
